The '''UR41-284 system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[UR41-284]], [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of a [[Unidentified UR41-284 species|sentient species]].
